title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.6.0 extends the course through Week 15. Week 13 includes the retained Re=1000, D/W=2.2 cavity field at checkpoint 55118 and separately labelled continuation training loss through checkpoint 65711; matched CFD validation is not claimed. Week 14 teaches Davidson-based RANS, inverse PINN and neural closures, retaining the mixed velocity/turbulence-energy tradeoff and reproduction limitations. Week 15 includes 130 sampled OpenFOAM fields, explicit geometry splits, geometry-aware operator audits and separate ordinary-DeepONet DSMC evidence. Revised notebooks expose teaching algorithms rather than only helper calls. Upstream research sources and dataset permissions remain separately attributed.
